name: iris-sandbox
//: node_modules / cargo target / caches live in named volumes so the container never clobbers the host's host-built artifacts. NOTE: VS Code wires up the toolchain but NOT the egress allowlist — that filtering proxy is only applied by run-sandbox.sh. Use that script for autonomous (--dangerously-skip-permissions) runs.
//overrideCommand: Keep the container alive for VS Code instead of running the Claude entrypoint.
postCreateCommand: pip install -r engine/requirements.lock -r engine/requirements-dev.txt && npm install --no-audit --no-fund
